name: AutoLED
description: Place WS2812 / SMD LEDs as a 2D grid inside a shape from an SVG, PNG or BMP image.
description_full:
Fills a shape taken from an SVG, PNG, BMP or JPG image (converted to black & white with a configurable threshold) with a 2D grid of LEDs such as WS2812B, SK6812MINI, 0805, 0603 or 1206.
Settings: scale, LED pitch, border offset, grid shift, placement mode, rotation, board side, direction, zigzag and start corner.
Outputs: JSON, TXT and a C/C++ header with the LED map and index; a schematic (daisy chain or row/column matrix); footprints placed on the PCB with nets; an optional board outline following the shape; and optional autorouting with Freerouting.
